meta.name: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
meta.description: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. He is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made, forming a new team of Librarians.

videos.title: And the Deadly Drekavac
videos.overview: When a Librarian from 200 years ago reappears today, he brings back to life a long-closed magical Library and accidentally resurrects an evil Drekavac. The Librarian, along with a quickly assembled team, must stop the Drekavac before it can kill and multiply.

videos.title: And the Dance of Doom
videos.overview: Our newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious "dancing sickness," leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

videos.title: And the Ghost Train
videos.overview: Half of the team becomes trapped on a runaway ghost train, and the rest of the team must help solve the unresolved business of the ghosts on board.

videos.title: And the Thief of Love
videos.overview: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake.

videos.title: And the Memory Crystal
videos.overview: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

videos.title: And the House of Cards
videos.overview: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunnit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

videos.title: And the Con-Con
videos.overview: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

videos.title: And the Hangover from Hell
videos.overview: After a wild bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

videos.title: And the Feast of the Vampir
videos.overview: While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

videos.title: And Going Medieval
videos.overview: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847 (via a homemade time machine), he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and ... Elaine.

videos.title: And the Graffiti of the Gods
videos.overview: When graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl, the team have to work out how these strange events are related to Gregor's Hammer -- and the imminent return of Gregor himself.

videos.title: And the Unfinished Business
videos.overview: General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia (remember from the Train episode), gaining control of their nuclear arsenal. The team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

videos.title: And the Burning Heart
videos.overview: When the Librarians are sent to an international boarding school to investigate an outbreak of inexplicable rage, they encounter a mysterious man claiming to be the legendary wizard Merlin. Together, the group must overcome their own anger and uncover the source of the magic before time runs out.

videos.title: And the Tethered Wish
videos.overview: A freed genie is granting wishes across Belgrade, leaving chaos in his wake. The Librarians must return the genie to his bottle before his magic spirals out of control ... a task that proves difficult when Vikram makes a hasty wish.

videos.title: And the Vanishing Bankers
videos.overview: The Librarians discover a sinister new incarnation of Peter Pan is recruiting the next generation of Lost Boys. When Charlie becomes one of his captives, the team must venture into a twisted version of Neverland.

videos.title: And the Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: When Connor is bewitched by a "smell spell" and becomes a contestant on a cooking competition show, the Librarians must break the enchantment by defeating the show's hosts.

videos.title: And the Red Rock
videos.overview: The Librarians discover that the charming young scientist Lysa is dating is actually the Red Rock, a superhero battling a crime wave across Belgrade.

videos.title: And Descartes' Dilemma
videos.overview: While on a mission to recover the missing bracelets of Castor and Pollux, the Librarians accidentally swap bodies with one another.

videos.title: And the Monkey's Paw
videos.overview: While pursuing a Monkey's Paw, the Librarians become trapped in a strange hotel shrouded in a mysterious fog. To escape, the team must confront past traumas, and, in the process, learn the difference between what they wish for and what they truly need.

videos.title: And the Last Resort
videos.overview: The Librarians investigate an magical ley line at a 200-year-old resort known for its venerable puppet theater. Their attempt to turn the mission into a vacation is thwarted when they uncover a sentient puppet's evil scheme to destroy the resort.

videos.title: And the Toy Phone
videos.overview: While the rest of the team is away on a Library retreat, Charlie receives a call on a mysterious toy phone from a child trapped in a haunted house. To save the child, Charlie must enlist the help of original Librarians Jacob Stone and Cassandra Cillian.

videos.title: And the Heart of a Librarian
videos.overview: The Librarians must help Vikram's long-lost love Anya unravel a mystery from the past -- through letters sent across time -- before the magical events she faces in the Victorian era ripple forward with consequences for the future.

videos.title: And What Dreams May Come
videos.overview: A distress call from Merlin leads the Librarians to a town where the entire population has mysteriously fallen asleep. As they search for the magical artifact behind the enchantment, the team must confront their darkest nightmares brought vividly to life.

videos.title: And the Camelot Conundrum
videos.overview: The Librarians face their deadliest mission yet when a power-hungry Merlin returns to Camelot, determined to rewrite both the past and the future. Now, the team must stop the formidable wizard and prevent the collapse of time itself -- or die trying.
